'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Have you seen the news? Recently, media have been pushing the agenda that "the Blue Helmets are not doing their job in Tarkov, do not follow the procedures" and so forth... Those damn bastards, kurwa! I hate these journalist scumbags. We are one step away from losing financing, which, my friend, is the opposite of profitable for us. So, we need to convince the public that the helmets are actually doing what they promised to do. You must address the issue of eliminating the illegal bandit group activities but do so under the UN flag. I'll give you the initial set of equipment you'll need, but if you lose it, don't come asking for more.}}

==Requirements==
* Must reach Loyalty Level 4 with [[Peacekeeper]] to obtain this quest.

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 12 [[Scavs]] while using UNTAR [[UNTAR helmet|helmet]] and [[MF-UNTAR body armor|armor]], and 5.56x45 UN weapons on [[Woods]] or [[Reserve]]
* Eliminate 12 [[Scavs]] while using UNTAR [[UNTAR helmet|helmet]] and [[MF-UNTAR body armor|armor]], and 5.56x45 UN weapons on [[Customs]] or [[Lighthouse]]
* Eliminate 12 [[Scavs]] while using UNTAR [[UNTAR helmet|helmet]] and [[MF-UNTAR body armor|armor]], and 5.56x45 UN weapons on [[Shoreline]] or [[Streets of Tarkov]]
* Eliminate 12 [[Scavs]] while using UNTAR [[UNTAR helmet|helmet]] and [[MF-UNTAR body armor|armor]], and 5.56x45 UN weapons on [[Ground Zero]] or [[Interchange]]

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* +2 [[Aim Drills|Aim Drills skill]] levels
* [[Peacekeeper]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 2,750 Dollars
** 2,888 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 3,163 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Desert Tech MDR 7.62x51 assault rifle]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[Desert Tech MDR 7.62x51 assault rifle]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL4
* Unlocks barter for [[Cult Locust ballistic plate]] at [[Skier]] LL4
{{quote|Ah, is that you? My superiors are pleased with the results! There are now fewer Scavs in the area, and attacks from the media died down a bit! Plus, we've made some nice photos for the newspapers. Good work, my friend!}}
